descriptions.text: The BA South and Southeast Asian Studies program is completed with a thesis. In this thesis; the student reports in writing on research into a self-chosen topic that he/she has conducted under the supervision of a lecturer from the study programme. A general introduction to the dissertation writing process is given in association with the Current Affairs/Heritage/Futures seminar close to the beginning of that course; and the choice of supervisor should have been made by the end of the third week of the second semester. Later in the course; students give work-in-progress presentations on their dissertations. During these presentations they obtain critical feedback from other students; from the seminar coordinator; and from any other contributing lecturer.

Dissertation (100%)The main text of the dissertation should be approximately 8;500 words in length. The maximum length including notes; bibliography; and any appendices; is 10;000 words. Wherever possible; a reasonable quantity of source materials in Indonesian; Hindi; Sanskrit or Tibetan should be used in researching and writing the dissertation.Regulations and procedures concerning the bachelor’s thesis can be found [here](https://www.student.universiteitleiden.nl/en/your-study-programme/thesis-and-papers/humanities/ancient-near-eastern-studies-ba?cf=humanities&cd=ancient-near-eastern-studies-ba#tab-1).BA Theses are written in English. Permission to write in a different language may be granted by the Examinations Committee. Any application for such permission must be submitted at the same time as the supervisor is selected; and must take into account the necessity of finding a second reader (see below) who is also able to understand the language in question
Propaedeutics and a completed second year of bachelor's programme in South and Southeast Asian Studies.

* For substantive questions; contact the lecturer listed in the right information bar.* For questions about enrolment; admission; etc; contact the Education Administration Office:[Herta Mohr](https://www.organisatiegids.universiteitleiden.nl/en/faculties-and-institutes/humanities/faculty-office/student-affairs/education-administration-offices#herta-mohr).

Self-study under the guidance of a supervisor. Student and supervisor have at least four meetings during the writing process. Students themselves choose a supervisor for their BA dissertation from among the lecturers involved in the SSE Asian Studies programme. They do this in consultation with the coordinator of the third year; second semester seminar course ‘Current Affairs/Heritage/Futures of South and Southeast Asia’; which forms part of the framework in which the dissertation is prepared.

#### Review and feedback

Any student who has handed in a final thesis that is evaluated as insufficient by both examiners at the deadline may rewrite it and hand in a new version within 6 months of the first submission deadline. No supervision will be offered during this period.

descriptions.value: Acquiring knowledge by systematically and methodically inquiring into a situation or concept, making use of methods appropriate to the academic field or discipline.
Kennis verwerven door het systematisch en methodisch bevragen van een situatie of concept waarbij gebruik gemaakt wordt van methoden die passen bij het vakgebied of de discipline.
Analysing situations or information and deciding what is of major and lesser importance. Seeing interrelationships and getting to the core of the matter.
Ontleden van situaties of een hoeveelheid informatie in hoofd- en bijzaken. Zien van onderlinge verbanden en doordringen tot de kern.
Using digital technology, methods, sources or databases to achieve results.
Gebruiken van digitale technologie, methoden, bronnen of databases om resultaten te behalen.
Setting out ideas and information clearly in writing, taking account of the relevant target group and in such a way that the message is received and understood.
Ideeën en informatie helder op schrift stellen, rekening houdend met de doelgroep, en zodanig dat de boodschap overkomt en wordt begrepen.
Conveying ideas and information clearly to an audience, taking account of the target group and using appropriate supporting materials and platforms.
Ideeën en informatie op heldere wijze overbrengen aan een publiek, rekening houdend met de doelgroep. Hierbij worden passende ondersteunende materialen en platformen gebruikt.
Being well-informed about societal, political and discipline-related developments and being aware of own role and influence within these developments.
Goed geïnformeerd zijn over de maatschappelijke, politieke en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkelingen en zich bewust zijn van de eigen rol en invloed binnen deze ontwikkelingen.
Self-directing own process of absorbing and applying new knowledge and information.
Zelf sturing geven aan het eigen proces van nieuwe kennis en informatie opnemen en toepassen.
The ability to continue performing effectively in changing and challenging circumstances; to cope with setbacks and recover from them.
Het vermogen om effectief te blijven functioneren in veranderende, uitdagende omstandigheden. Om kunnen gaan met en herstellen van tegenslag.
